onboarding.title: Terms & Privacy Consent
onboarding.body:
Before you start **Idle Factory**, please review the terms.

· Use the buttons below to view the **Terms of Service** and **Privacy Policy**.
· When you agree to both, press **`Agree & Start`** to create your account.
· Account creation grants **1,000💰** seed money and your first land (3×3).

-# Your consent timestamp is stored for audit purposes.
